Method of Attack: Ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) operation involving affiliates breaching and encrypting victims
Hijacking ransom negotiations to cut affiliates out of payments
Using a cryptographic scheme with a master private key to decrypt any systems locked by the ransomware
Deploying a 'cryptobackdoor' in ransomware samples allowing operators to decrypt victim systems
Taking over ransom negotiations by posing as victims quitting negotiations
Using multiple public-private key pairs for encryption and decryption tasks
Double-dipping practices to steal entire ransom payments
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note containing a blob of data with machine, campaign, malware version, and system private key information
